examples.title: fMRIPrep's slice-timing correction of a real BOLD run
examples.summary: The 3dTshift node fMRIPrep 25.2.6 ran on OpenNeuro ds005040 sub-002 (task clip, run 1): its arguments and the slice times it wrote, given to AFNI 25.2.09, to AFNI 26.3.05 (the replica's reference since 2026-10-29) and to both LARMORX implementations, each in its default and reproduce mode and at 1 and 12 threads. fMRIPrep's own output is the column it produced in its run. The clean-room original is compared with AFNI 25.2.09, its reference until it follows 26.3.05's two fixes.

facts.label: Data
facts.text: OpenNeuro ds005040, task clip run 1, sub-002 (CC0-1.0): 64 × 64 × 40 × 63 int16 values, 63 volumes; shown inside fMRIPrep's BOLD brain mask, dilated by one voxel

facts.label: Slice times
facts.text: 40 slices, ascending, 0 to 1.95 s into each TR of 2 s, shifted to 0.975 s

facts.label: Programs
facts.text: AFNI 25.2.09 and AFNI 26.3.05 (the repository's oracle builds); larmorx-gpl 0.0.1 (the replica); larmorx's clean-room original at commit `a58978f4dfd1`

facts.label: AFNI versions
facts.text: AFNI 26.3.05 (the GPL replica's reference since 2026-10-29) on the same arguments as AFNI 25.2.09: the same bytes in every output of fMRIPrep's call. What changed between the two releases in these programs (header slice code 2, AFNI-03; `-no_detrend`, AFNI-05; both corrected by LARMORX before AFNI fixed them) does not meet this call.
